scope: flat contiguous PER/ORG mentions in original Spanish strings
annotationPolicy: PER includes full personal name and internal particles, excludes titles
ORG includes full organization name and internal particles, excludes generic company/association prefix unless part of name
No nested, overlapping, discontinuous entities or entity linking
All unannotated text is outside scope; language/product names are not ORG
No real personal records; one author, no inter-annotator agreement measured
evaluation: exact label/start/end per document; micro P/R/F1, counts and errors by type; token accuracy supplemental only

plannedTraining.model: linear softmax BIO token classifier with lexical/context/shape features; not Transformer
plannedTraining.selection: fixed protocol; no test-driven tuning; report all seeds

status: frozen before first fitting; no trained results yet
limitations: 32 hand-authored sentences, not representative or blind
Entity strings may repeat across splits for ambiguity stress (Alba); full mentions otherwise separated
Some syntactic structures repeat; not a template-family holdout
No conclusions about production quality or pretrained Transformers
